title: Choosing Inner Freedom:
headline: Everyone knows the moment somebody pushes their buttons. FTC teaches people to answer from somewhere calm, and they do it in prison.
story: We open on something every viewer knows: somebody pushed your buttons. The client's own voice-over walks you from that moment to inner freedom. Then the surprise: “We just happen to teach it in prison.” Then Eddie, who learned it inside and now leads the workshops.

This is the video for the landing page of the year-end campaign. It must feel confident and hopeful. The viewer is invited to join. The viewer is never asked to feel sorry. Not about crime. Not about how bad prison is.
